observations: Single photo shows a white industrial-style sewing machine mounted on a flat table with a metal leg/stand.
Thread spools and bobbin holders are visible on a small rack to the right.
A window with curtains is visible in the background, suggesting an indoor home or shop setting.
Image has a watermark overlay reading 'POSTED BY EVELYN ATALI', indicating this is a reposted/aggregated listing photo.

risks.if_unproven: priced as a significant structural defect

risks.risk: Motor and stitching mechanism may not function properly
risks.proof: Short video clip of the machine powered on and sewing a line of stitches on fabric

risks.risk: Missing or non-matching accessories (bobbins, needles, motor pedal, belt)
risks.proof: Photo showing all included accessories laid out together
risks.if_unproven: priced as base unit only, no accessories

risks.risk: Table and stand condition (rust, wobble, missing parts) not fully visible
risks.proof: Photos from underneath and side angles showing stand joints and table underside

risks.risk: True brand/model unconfirmed, which affects comparable pricing

risks.if_unproven: priced as a generic unbranded industrial sewing machine

proof_requests: Close-up photo of the crack on the board, including its full length and position relative to the stitching area
Video of the machine running and stitching on a piece of fabric
Clear photo of any brand/model nameplate or sticker on the machine head
Photo of all included accessories (bobbins, needles, pedal, belt, oil can, etc.)
Photo of the table underside and stand joints for structural condition
response.reason: The item is clearly identifiable by type as an industrial sewing machine with table and stand, but the seller's claimed crack and working condition are unverified from the single wide photo, so it must be priced at worst case (significant defect, unconfirmed function) until close-up and video proof are provided.
